title: LLPSense predicts condition-dependent phase separation with language-model embeddings
summary: LLPSense combines protein language model embeddings with environmental parameters to predict phase separation. Experimental validations support its predictions; the model revealed temperature-dependent reentrant phase behavior in SGTA, not previously known to phase-separate, and predicted alpha-synuclein mutations that enhance or suppress phase separation, with model-guided mutagenesis modulating phase behavior.
